volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

morph.tooltip: 0…1 width/duty. 0.5 = center / 50%. Trisaw, Pulse, and Center Square (pulse grows from mid-cycle — not a stepped square). Morph MOD jack on the param row.

mix.tooltip: Wet/dry balance for the reverb output.

recycle.tooltip: Feedback amount for the reverb tail.

seed.tooltip: Randomizes the delay line pattern. Same seed always reproduces the same reverb character.

mode.tooltip: Real-pole stacks. LP / HP use High Cut / Low Cut. BP is HP then LP. Old LP6/BP6/HP6 values stay 0/1/2.

slope.tooltip: Cascaded real 1-poles. 6 dB = one pole; 24 dB = four. No resonance.

stagger.tooltip: Pole spread ratio k. 1 = same freq; ~1.5 gentle spread; above ~2.2 a stair-step. No effect at 6 dB.

lowFrequency.tooltip: Highpass cutoff (HP and BP). Sweep moves this with High Cut in musical steps.

highFrequency.tooltip: Lowpass cutoff (LP and BP). Sweep moves this with Low Cut in musical steps.

sweep.tooltip: Shift used cutoffs in semitones. BP keeps the Low/High interval (ratio) constant.

gainCompensation.tooltip: On = scale poles so the labeled cutoff is −3 dB. Off = every pole sits on the staggered freqs. No effect at 6 dB.

pulseWidth.tooltip: Gate high duty of each cycle (0..1). 0.5 = square. Affects Gate 0-1 / Gate -1+1.

timeNumerator.tooltip: Numerator of Numer/Denom × whole note, locked to master playhead. Numer=0 → no clock. 1/4 = one beat at BPM.

timeDenominator.tooltip: Denominator of Numer/Denom × whole note. At Numer=1: Denom 4=¼, 8=⅛, 16=1/16, 32=1/32.

timingMode.tooltip: Normal = Numer/Denom as written. Dotted = 1.5×. Triplet = 2/3×. Always re-grids onto master time — never free-runs.

gravity.tooltip: Stickiness of step direction (higher = more inertia).

leap.tooltip: Base chance of a larger jump (added to Leap CV).

offset.tooltip: Bias. Off/On choices by default. Min, max, reverse, curve, and smooth time are Parameter Settings.

displaySource.tooltip: Mouse = pointer target. Smoothed = Bias after Parameter Settings smooth.
